messages.text:
"Rune factory 4 mixed with the sims 2 styled game on android

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.

<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('world'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const S={day:1,hour:8,gold:48,energy:84,hunger:72,mood:80,seeds:5,harvest:0,turnips:0,friend:0,relationship:0,scene:'farm',action:'farm',wish:0,plots:Array.from({length:6},()=>({crop:null,water:false,age:0})),forage:0,logs:['A new chapter begins in Willowbrook.'],weather:'sunny',rain:false};
let W=0,H=0,dpr=1,toastTimer,hoverPlot=-1,player={x:.53,y:.61};
function resize(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);W=r.width;H=r.height;canvas.width=Math.round(W*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(H*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);draw()}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
const rand=(n)=>{let x=Math.sin(n*127.1+311.7)*43758.5453;return x-Math.floor(x)};
function rounded(x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);if(fill){ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill()}if(stroke){ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke()}}
function ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,color){ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fill()}
function line(x1,y1,x2,y2,color,width=1){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.stroke()}
function text(t,x,y,size,color='#34483a',align='center',weight='700'){ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.font=`${weight} ${size}px ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign=align;ctx.fillText(t,x,y)}
function draw(){if(!W||!H)return;ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);drawLandscape();if(S.scene==='farm')drawFarm();else drawWoods();drawPeople();drawDecor();}
function drawLandscape(){let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,H);g.addColorStop(0,S.scene==='farm'?'#b8d5a5':'#9bc294');g.addColorStop(.52,S.scene==='farm'?'#a9ca91':'#83b081');g.addColorStop(1,'#8eb77e');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
// sunlit grass flecks
for(let i=0;i<190;i++){let x=rand(i+4)*W,y=rand(i+800)*H;ellipse(x,y,1+rand(i+99)*1.5,1+rand(i+3),i%3?'#d8e6b866':'#6d9d6d55')}
// curving little lane
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-20,H*.79);ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*.24,H*.64,W*.49,H*.8,W*.62,H*.57);ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*.74,H*.34,W*.84,H*.47,W+20,H*.35);ctx.lineTo(W+20,H*.47);ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*.83,H*.56,W*.77,H*.42,W*.66,H*.66);ctx.bezierCurveTo(W*.51,H*.9,W*.25,H*.75,-20,H*.9);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle='#ddc99c';ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#eadbb9';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.stroke();
// path little stepping stones
for(let i=0;i<13;i++){let x=W*(.06+i*.077),y=H*(.81-i*.018+Math.sin(i*.65)*.04);ellipse(x,y,5,2.4,'#c7b58f')}
}
function drawHouse(x,y,s){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(s,s);ellipse(0,35,70,12,'#51704b55');rounded(-54,-11,108,52,4,'#eadcb7','#b69d6e');ctx.fillStyle='#b86650';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-65,-12);ctx.lineTo(0,-62);ctx.lineTo(65,-12);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#904c40';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.stroke();line(-48,-14,0,-52,'#d58a70',3);line(-28,-28,-28,-10,'#d58a70',2);line(0,-49,48,-12,'#d58a70',3);rounded(-10,8,21,33,3,'#9b694a','#704c39');rounded(-43,2,20,19,3,'#a9d0c3','#f8edcf');line(-33,3,-33,20,'#f8edcf',2);line(-43,11,-23,11,'#f8edcf',2);rounded(23,2,20,19,3,'#a9d0c3','#f8edcf');line(33,3,33,20,'#f8edcf',2);line(23,11,43,11,'#f8edcf',2);rounded(30,-60,12,25,2,'#a95747');text('✿',-47,-24,11,'#ffecbe');ctx.restore()}
function tree(x,y,s=1,shade=0){ellipse(x,y+12*s,22*s,8*s,'#426b4c66');ctx.fillStyle=shade?'#52805b':'#477653';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y-49*s);ctx.lineTo(x-25*s,y+3*s);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+15*s,x+25*s,y+3*s);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ellipse(x,y-23*s,19*s,22*s,shade?'#78a875':'#629360');ellipse(x-9*s,y-27*s,8*s,9*s,'#8bb77b');ellipse(x+8*s,y-18*s,7*s,8*s,'#3f704c');line(x,y+1*s,x,y+12*s,'#795a3c',5*s)}
function drawFarm(){drawHouse(W*.77,H*.36,Math.min(W,H)/500+.7); // cottage
// fence boundary
ctx.strokeStyle='#f0dfb8';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.setLineDash([]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W*.04,H*.31);ctx.lineTo(W*.51,H*.31);ctx.lineTo(W*.51,H*.84);ctx.lineTo(W*.04,H*.84);ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();for(let i=0;i<18;i++){let x=W*(.04+i*.027);line(x,H*.30,x,H*.325,'#bd9b69',2)}
// garden plots six interactive beds
let pw=Math.min(W*.135,90),ph=Math.min(H*.16,72),gap=Math.min(W*.018,12);let startX=W*.10,startY=H*.40;
S.plots.forEach((p,i)=>{let col=i%3,row=Math.floor(i/3),x=startX+col*(pw+gap),y=startY+row*(ph+gap);const active=S.action==='farm'&&hoverPlot===i;rounded(x,y,pw,ph,9,active?'#78563d':'#886344',active?'#ffe89a':'#6f5039');rounded(x+4,y+4,pw-8,ph-8,6,p.water?'#694a35':'#79583c');for(let k=0;k<4;k++)line(x+8,y+12+k*12,x+pw-8,y+12+k*12,p.water?'#80644b':'#9e7a52',2);
if(p.crop){let stage=p.age>=2?'ripe':p.age===1?'growing':'sprout';let n=stage==='ripe'?4:stage==='growing'?3:2;for(let j=0;j<n;j++){let cx=x+pw*(.27+(j%2)*.46),cy=y+ph*(.44+Math.floor(j/2)*.26);if(stage==='ripe'){ellipse(cx,cy,7,7,'#5c9549');ellipse(cx-2,cy-2,4,4,'#94bf61');ellipse(cx+4,cy-4,3.8,3.8,'#e7bd53');}else{line(cx,cy+6,cx,cy-5,p.water?'#517a43':'#668d4d',2);ellipse(cx-3,cy-4,4,2,'#9cc76b');ellipse(cx+3,cy-6,4,2,'#86b85e')}}if(stage==='ripe')text('✦',x+pw-12,y+15,12,'#ffe784');else if(!p.water)text('💧',x+pw-12,y+14,11)}else{ellipse(x+pw/2,y+ph/2,4,3,'#a58a69');if(active)text('＋',x+pw/2,y+ph/2+6,21,'#fff0c4')}
if(active){ctx.strokeStyle='#ffe89a';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeRect(x+1,y+1,pw-2,ph-2)}p.bounds={x,y,w:pw,h:ph};});
// little well and flowerbeds
ellipse(W*.47,H*.72,19,7,'#628b8b');rounded(W*.45,H*.66,38,20,6,'#a89269','#786449');ellipse(W*.47,H*.65,19,8,'#659b9d');line(W*.45,H*.65,W*.49,H*.65,'#d3c59c',2);text('✿',W*.40,H*.78,15,'#f5d276');text('✿',W*.48,H*.80,13,'#e99885');tree(W*.13,H*.25,.78,1);tree(W*.36,H*.22,.95);tree(W*.56,H*.28,.73,1);tree(W*.92,H*.69,.88);tree(W*.88,H*.22,.75,1);
}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Android-friendly game inspired by Rune Factory 4 and The Sims 2.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support responsive mobile layouts and touch controls.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original cozy farming-and-social game, “Hearthwild,” as a standalone HTML canvas game with no external assets or dependencies.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented farm and woods scenes, interactive planting/watering/harvesting, foraging, neighbor conversations, needs, time progression, daily wishes, journal, and localStorage saves.
- Added responsive layouts and touch interactions in `index.html`.
- Checked JavaScript syntax and exercised planting, day advancement, and foraging in Chromium; no page errors observed.
- Captured and inspected a mobile JPEG screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/hearthwild-mobile.jpg`.

### Active
- Fix/verify touch interaction and crop harvesting after day advancement; one initial test clicked a point that was inside the first plot only after responsive layout changes and reported no harvest. Re-test using plot bounds from the current layout.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` could not launch because its expected Chromium installation was missing (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`); direct `/usr/bin/chromium` automation worked instead.

## Next Move
1. Re-test planting, day progression, watering, and harvesting using current canvas bounding boxes at mobile viewport.
2. Recheck the latest desktop and mobile screenshots if changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/hearthwild-mobile.jpg`: Latest inspected mobile screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/hearthwild.js`: Extracted JavaScript used for `node --check`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The first mobile browser run showed the canvas at 425.6px wide despite a 390px viewport; responsive CSS was then adjusted. Current geometry reports a 368px-wide canvas within the 390px viewport.
